doc.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003

title: Requests from Jon Hendricks
summary: Jon Hendricks wants the rhythm section written out and a rare Dizzy Gillespie record.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: It’s going — there are two things that I’ve got to do for Jon Hendricks when I get back to New York, he wants that written out, so you just send me a transcription you see, and I’m done.

And the second thing is he wants a very obscure Dizzy Gillespie record because he set some lyrics to “Scheherazade.” That theme [humms] I can’t sing it right now because I was thinking of something else and I don’t sing well. And Dizzy is on a pop record where somebody had set lyrics to it a zillion years ago with an organist and playing odd figures behind it. And apparently Jon’s got a gig and a record coming up so he needs to hear that. So I’m going to get that to him and the rhythm section thing. And that’s the two things he wants.
